messages:
Asha (oncall): paging everyone — eu-west-1 hosted inference started returning elevated 5xxs around 10:02 UTC, gradually worsened until ~10:16. We applied an emergency mitigation at 10:18 to route traffic to the dedicated pool and scale down the problematic model variant. impact: some customers saw failed generation calls and increased latency.

incident-bot: ALERT: 5xx spike detected on redwood-hosted-production (eu-west-1) — incident created. Paging oncall.

Sam (eng-sre): got it. I'm pulling logs and tracer spans now. Can someone confirm whether the KV cache warmups were happening at that time?

Miguel (infra): quick summary from infra side: autoscaler triggered a parallel reprovision when model variant B-quant resumed, some nodes OOMed on kernel side for long-seq requests. The fallback path to B-fp16 wasn't configured for that routing policy, so requests retried and piled up.

Priya (ops): timeline note: 10:02 alert, 10:05 requeues start, 10:12 errors > threshold, 10:18 mitigation (traffic shift + canary disable). Need to schedule a postmortem and customer comms.

Leah (Customer Success): affected customers list? I already have two AMs pinging — want a concise summary we can send to them. Prefer: what happened, who was affected, what we did, and next steps.

Asha (oncall): Jordan — can you assemble affected-account list and severity buckets? I can draft the first customer note.

Jordan (support): on it. Pulling query for requests with 5xx between 10:00-10:20 in eu-west-1 and mapping to customer_tenant_id. Will paste results here when done.

Miguel (infra): root cause hypothesis: kernel memory regression in the B-quant runtime introduced in 2026-03-09 canary. Under long-sequence prompt shapes, the allocator failed to release some fused buffers. We'll need a reproducer and revert candidate.

Sam (eng-sre): confirmed OOM stack traces matching Miguel's note. I'll attach logs to the postmortem binder. Also saw a cascade: autoscaler spin-up added transient pressure. Suggest we adjust autoscaler cooldown and add a capacity circuit-breaker for model variants.

Evelyn (PM): let's block a 60min postmortem tomorrow. Available slots: 09:00-11:00 UTC. Priya — can you coordinate? We'll include infra, runtime, srep, support, CS.

Priya (ops): scheduling now. Proposed: 2026-04-02 09:30 UTC. I'll add calendar invite and preread (timeline + artifacts).

Leah (Customer Success): draft for customers:

```
Short summary: Between 10:02-10:18 UTC on 2026-04-01 we observed an increase in failed generation requests for hosted inference in eu-west-1. Root cause: a memory regression in a recent model runtime variant (B-quant) that caused node OOMs under long-sequence traffic and led to retries and queueing. Mitigation: we routed traffic to our dedicated pool and disabled the affected variant; full service restored by 10:23 UTC. Impact: a subset of tenants experienced transient failed requests and elevated latency; no data loss. Next steps: postmortem, targeted rollback of the runtime change, and customer-facing RCA within 72 hours.
```

Asha (oncall): nice. Add estimated affected % if Jordan can surface it. Also add actions and owners — we need clear remediation timing.

Jordan (support): quick numbers: 27 tenants had >1 failed call; top 5 tenants account for ~78% of 5xx volume. Total failed calls ~4.6k during window.

Asha (oncall): ok assigning actions — I'll keep this brief and actionable.

```
Action items:
- Miguel: produce reproducer and revert candidate for B-quant runtime (owner, due 2026-04-03)
- Sam: add autoscaler cooldown and capacity circuit-breaker (owner, PR by 2026-04-05)
- Priya: schedule and run the postmortem (owner, meeting 2026-04-02 09:30 UTC)
- Leah & Jordan: customer impact summaries and per-tenant notes (owner, initial comm by 2026-04-01 18:00 UTC)
- Evelyn: review communication and approve customer RCA draft (owner, by 2026-04-03)
- Asha: final incident timeline and attach logs to binder (owner, by 2026-04-02)
```

Miguel (infra): ack. I'll start with a binary revert branch and put repro instructions in the binder.

Sam (eng-sre): I'll draft the autoscaler change as a flag-gated rollout so we can test without global impact.

Priya (ops):postmortem invite sent. Agenda: tl;dr, timeline, root cause, contributing factors, actions, owners, verification plan. Please add any preread artifacts.

Leah (Customer Success): customer note ready to send after Jordan's per-tenant numbers. I'll include the support contact and offer a 1:1 if they want. :handshake:

Jordan (support): pasted quick table: top5-tenant-ids: t-914, t-201, t-334, t-777, t-002 — these combined ~78%. I'll DM the full list to Leah and AMs (PII safe).

Asha (oncall): handoff — Miguel will take oncall for follow-ups. @Miguel please ack and we'll transition.

Miguel (infra): acked. I'll monitor rollout of the revert and leave a note in the incident binder.

Evelyn (PM): small ask for the customer comm: include concrete verification criteria for when we consider this closed (e.g., no recurrence for 7d under same traffic shapes, autoscaler flag enabled, and revert deployed).

Asha (oncall): agreed. Add verification step to actions.

Asha (oncall): closing this thread for live mitigation — moving to postmortem workflow. Customer comm draft link: https://status.redwood.ai/incidents/2177778888 (internal-only until approved).

incident-bot: Incident 2177778888 status changed: mitigated -> postmortem_scheduled.

Leah (Customer Success): will send initial customer brief by 18:00 UTC and coordinate follow-up RCA after postmortem.

Sam (eng-sre): leaving notes in binder: /mnt/binders/2177778888/timeline.md and attaching logs.

Priya (ops): thanks team — great collaboration. We'll track action items in the remediation sprint board and update status next business day. :calendar: :thumbsup:

Asha (oncall): thanks all. If anything else comes up, ping #incidents and I'll re-open.
